decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation came out of the firm's own R&D, probably with research partners, and fits its announced digital, energy-recovery direction, so management would see slow early uptake as temporary and keep it.
The weir dimensioning web tool is cheap to keep online and serves engineering planners, a core customer group, and nothing suggests its results have disappointed enough to justify writing it off.

The fouling detection system is a proprietary hardware and software product with substantial development investment and visible public commitment, which makes dropping it so soon after launch unlikely.
